d=json.load(open('canonical-input.json'))
for name,s in d['learnerSubmissions'].items():

  root=E.fromstring(svg)
  labels=[x.text for x in root.findall('{*}text')]
  marks=[tuple(float(v) for v in x[1:-1].split(';')) for x in labels[:4]]
  knots=[(float(x.get('x')),float(x.get('y'))+5) for x in root.findall('{*}text')[:4]]
  axis=labels[4][0];A=marks[0][0]==2
  xx=[tuple(map(float,p)) for p in re.findall(r'[ML]([-\\d.]+),([-\\d.]+)',root.findall('{*}path')[1].get('d'))]
  x0=xx[0][0];x1=xx[-1][0];u0=marks[0][1];slope=(u0-marks[-1][1])/(xx[0][1]-xx[-1][1]) if u0"'!=marks[-1][1] else 0
  def expected(u):
   if A:return {'"'s':5-u+u*u,'a':2,'v':-1+2*u}[axis]
   return {'s':6*u-u*u,'a':-2,'v':6-2*u}[axis]
  errs=[]
  for x,y in xx:
   u=(2 if A else 3)*(x-x0)/(x1-x0)
   errs.append(abs(expected(u)-(u0+slope*(y-xx[0][1]))))
  print(name,'A' if A else 'B',axis,len(xx),len(set(v[1] for v in xx)),max(errs))
